007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
011
012import javax.sql.DataSource;
013import java.sql.SQLException;
014
015/** Creates a DataSource-backed SelectAIAgent client. */
016public final class CreateSelectAIAgentDataSourceSample {
017    private CreateSelectAIAgentDataSourceSample() {
018    }
019
020    /**
021     * Creates and closes a DataSource-backed SelectAIAgent client.
022     *
023     * @param args command-line arguments; not used
024     * @throws SQLException when DataSource configuration fails
025     * @throws SelectAIException when client cleanup fails
026     */
027    public static void main(String[] args) throws SQLException, SelectAIException {
028        DataSource dataSource = SelectAIAgentConnectionSampleSupport.dataSource();
029        try (SelectAIAgent ignored = SelectAIAgent.create(dataSource)) {
030            System.out.println("Created DataSource-backed SelectAIAgent client.");
031        }
032    }
033}
